```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT component_id, per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721')
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.component_id, bt.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
)
SELECT SUM(bt.qty) AS total_qty
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-0253';
```

)

        so.order_id,
        sol.product_id AS root_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,

    JOIN bill_of_materials bom
      ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id

     AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of FR-M63S-38
    SELECT 
        p_assembly.product_id AS assembly_product_id,
        p_assembly.product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_assembly,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM product p_assembly
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p_assembly.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE p_assembly.product_number = 'FR-M63S-38'
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.component_id AS assembly_product_id,
        be.component_product_number AS assembly_product_number,
        bom.component_id,
        p_component.product_number AS component_product_number,
        p_component.make_flag,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_assembly,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1 AS bom_level
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p_component ON bom.component_id = p_component.product_id
    WHERE be.make_flag = true  -- only explode manufactured items
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE component_product_number = 'MS-2341';

WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    SELECT
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        b.start_date,
        b.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        bp.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        bp.qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        b.start_date,
        b.end_date
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bp.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = bp.component_id AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
part AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MB-6061'
),
orders AS (
    SELECT sol.product_id, sol.order_qty, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN o.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part) THEN o.order_qty ELSE 0 END
        +
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(bp.qty * o.order_qty)
            FROM bom_paths bp
            WHERE bp.assembly_id = o.product_id
              AND bp.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM part)
              AND bp.start_date <= o.order_date
              AND (bp.end_date IS NULL OR o.order_date <= bp.end_date)
        ), 0)
    ), 0) AS total_demand
FROM orders o;

    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),
bike_products AS (
    -- Get all products in the 'Bikes' category
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
component_ni_9522 AS (
    -- Get the product_id for component NI-9522
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'NI-9522'
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Recursive CTE to find all paths from bike products to components
    -- Start with bikes that have direct components in current BOM
    SELECT 
        cb.assembly_id AS bike_id,
        cb.component_id,
        cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.assembly_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM bike_products)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively follow sub-assemblies that are manufactured in-house
    SELECT 
        bp.bike_id,
        cb.component_id,
        bp.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN current_bom cb ON bp.component_id = cb.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON bp.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current date constant
current_date_const AS (SELECT DATE '2025-06-30' AS d),
-- Get product IDs for the two bikes
bike_products AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion for a given product
bom_parts AS (
    -- Anchor: start with top-level product
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date_const cd
    WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
        AND bom.start_date <= cd.d
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= cd.d)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components that are manufactured in-house
    SELECT 
        bp.root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bp.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bp.level + 1 AS level
    FROM bom_parts bp
    JOIN product p ON bp.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    CROSS JOIN current_date_const cd
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
        AND bom.start_date <= cd.d
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= cd.d)
),
-- Get all leaf parts (purchased components) for each bike
bike_parts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bp.root_product_id,
        bp.component_id AS part_id
    FROM bom_parts bp
    JOIN product p ON bp.component_id = p.product_id

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
    -- Get current BOM lines (valid as of 2025-06-30)
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= end_date)
),
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base: direct components of each bike
    SELECT 
        p.product_number AS top_level_bike,
        cb.component_id,
        cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM product p
    JOIN current_bom cb ON p.product_id = cb.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number IN ('BK-M47B-38', 'BK-M82S-44')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.top_level_bike,
        cb.component_id,
        be.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN current_bom cb ON be.component_id = cb.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true  -- only recurse into manufactured items
),
all_components AS (
    -- Get all components (including intermediate assemblies) with their top-level bike
    SELECT DISTINCT top_level_bike, component_id FROM bom_explosion
    
    UNION
    
    -- Include the bikes themselves as starting points (though they have make_flag=true typically)
    SELECT product_number, product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number IN ('BK-M47B-38', 'BK-M82S-44')
),
parts_in_bike AS (
    -- Find leaf parts (make_flag = false) reached from each bike
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        ac.top_level_bike,
        p.product_number AS part_number
    FROM all_components ac
    JOIN product p ON ac.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = false
)
-- Parts in BK-M47B-38 but not in BK-M82S-44
SELECT part_number 
FROM parts_in_bike 
WHERE top_level_bike = 'BK-M47B-38'

EXCEPT

SELECT part_number 
FROM parts_in_bike 
WHERE top_level_bike = 'BK-M82S-44'

ORDER BY part_number;
```

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: products sold directly in orders from Australia in 2025
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id AS assembly_id,
        sol.product_id AS component_id,
        sol.order_qty * 1.0 AS total_qty,
        sol.order_id,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON COALESCE(so.territory_id, c.territory_id) = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Australia'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode BOM components
    SELECT 
        be.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'PA-632U';

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all products in the 'Cranksets' subcategory
crankset_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number, p.name
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cranksets'
),
-- Get all sales in Southwest territory in 2025 that are non-online (reseller) orders
southwest_reseller_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.online_order = false
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get direct sales of crankset products
direct_crankset_sales AS (
    SELECT sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN southwest_reseller_orders swo ON sol.order_id = swo.order_id
    JOIN crankset_products cp ON sol.product_id = cp.product_id
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all crankset products that appear as components in BOMs
-- We need to find all paths where a crankset is a component at any level
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct BOM lines where component is a crankset
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty,
        1 as level
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.component_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM crankset_products)
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the assemblies from previous level
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.per_assembly_qty as per_assembly_qty,
        bp.level + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get all products that have cranksets as components (at any level)
products_with_cranksets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT assembly_id as product_id
    FROM bom_paths
),
-- For each order line of products containing cranksets, calculate crankset demand
indirect_crankset_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.component_id as product_id,
        sol.order_qty * bp.per_assembly_qty as total_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN southwest_reseller_orders swo ON sol.order_id = swo.order_id
    JOIN products_with_cranksets pwc ON sol.product_id = pwc.product_id
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON pwc.product_id = bp.assembly_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        -- Ensure the BOM path is valid on the order date
        SELECT 1 FROM bill_of_materials bom
        WHERE bom.assembly_id = bp.assembly_id
          AND bom.component_id = bp.component_id
          AND bom.start_date <= swo.order_date
          AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= swo.order_date)
    )
),
-- Combine direct and indirect sales
all_crankset_sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_qty as total_qty FROM direct_crankset_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT product_id, total_qty FROM indirect_crankset_demand
)

    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'TT-R982'
),

-- Get UK territory ID
uk_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id FROM sales_territory WHERE name = 'United Kingdom'
),

-- Get all order lines for UK in 2024 with their products and quantities
uk_orders_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        sol.order_id,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from sold products to TT-R982
-- Start from products that have TT-R982 somewhere in their BOM
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct BOM lines where component is TT-R982
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN part_info pi ON bom.component_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go up one level (find assemblies that contain the current assembly)
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id AS top_level_product_id,
        bp.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bp.total_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(bom.start_date, bp.start_date) AS start_date,
        LEAST(COALESCE(bom.end_date, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(bp.end_date, '9999-12-31')) AS end_date,
        bp.level + 1
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bom.component_id = bp.top_level_product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Calculate demand: direct sales of TT-R982 + component demand from BOM
demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of TT-R982
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN uk_territory ut ON so.territory_id = ut.territory_id
    JOIN part_info pi ON sol.product_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Component demand: for each order line, if the sold product has TT-R982 in its BOM valid on order date
component_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(
            uo.order_qty * bp.total_qty
        ), 0) AS component_demand
    FROM uk_orders_2024 uo
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON uo.sold_product_id = bp.top_level_product_id
    WHERE uo.order_date >= bp.start_date 
      AND (bp.end_date = '9999-12-31' OR uo.order_date <= bp.end_date)
)

SELECT 
    d.direct_demand + cd.component_demand AS total_demand
FROM demand d
CROSS JOIN component_demand cd
```

part_info AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'NI-4127'
),

-- Get all orders from Northwest territory in 2022

    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty

    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to track the original order line and accumulate the per-assembly quantity
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: start with products that are directly ordered and have BOMs
    -- Also include the case where the ordered product itself is the part we're looking for
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.product_id as root_product_id,
        no.order_qty,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_id as assembly_id,
        no.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as cumulative_qty,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM northwest_orders no
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as cumulative_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      -- Only expand if the component is manufactured in-house (has its own BOM)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true)
),

-- Get all paths where NI-4127 appears as a component (at any level)
ni_4127_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.cumulative_qty,
        be.order_qty * be.cumulative_qty as total_component_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN part_info pi ON be.component_id = pi.product_id
),

    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
germany_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Germany'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),
bom_recursive AS (
    -- Base: direct components of bike products
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: sub-components of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        br.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN product p ON br.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON br.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
bike_component_demand AS (
    -- For each bike, sum up all component demands (including the bike itself as a "component")
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN sol.product_id = bp.product_id THEN sol.order_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) +
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN sol.product_id != bp.product_id THEN sol.order_qty * br.total_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS total_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    LEFT JOIN germany_orders go ON true
    LEFT JOIN sales_order_line sol ON go.order_id = sol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN bom_recursive br ON bp.product_id = br.top_level_product_id AND sol.product_id = br.component_id
    WHERE sol.order_id IS NOT NULL
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM germany_orders WHERE 1=1)
    GROUP BY bp.product_id, bp.product_number
),
bike_direct_sales AS (
    -- Direct sales of bikes in Germany 2024
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id,
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) AS direct_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    LEFT JOIN sales_order_line sol ON bp.product_id = sol.product_id
    LEFT JOIN germany_orders go ON sol.order_id = go.order_id
    WHERE go.order_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bp.product_id, bp.product_number
),
bike_indirect_sales AS (
    -- Sales of components that are part of bikes
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty * br.total_qty), 0) AS indirect_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bom_recursive br ON bp.product_id = br.top_level_product_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON br.component_id = sol.product_id
    JOIN germany_orders go ON sol.order_id = go.order_id
    GROUP BY br.top_level_product_id, bp.product_number
),
total_bike_units AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id,
        bp.product_number,
        COALESCE(ds.direct_units, 0) + COALESCE(is.indirect_units, 0) AS total_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    LEFT JOIN bike_direct_sales ds ON bp.product_id = ds.product_id
    LEFT JOIN bike_indirect_sales is ON bp.product_id = is.top_level_product_id
)
SELECT product_number
FROM total_bike_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the product_id for FR-R92R-62
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),
-- Get all Northeast territory orders in 2023
northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to find paths from any product to FR-R92R-62
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: start from all products that are directly in orders
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_id AS root_product_id,
        no.product_id AS current_product_id,
        no.order_qty AS base_qty,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS path_multiplier,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM northeast_orders no
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        be.base_qty,
        be.path_multiplier * bom.per_assembly_qty AS path_multiplier,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
),
-- Calculate demand for FR-R92R-62 from each order line
-- This includes: direct sales of FR-R92R-62 + contained in other products
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.product_id,
        no.order_qty,
        -- Direct demand
        CASE WHEN no.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product) THEN no.order_qty ELSE 0 END AS direct_demand,
        -- Indirect demand through BOM
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(be.base_qty * be.path_multiplier)
            FROM bom_expansion be
            WHERE be.order_id = no.order_id
              AND be.root_product_id = no.product_id
              AND be.current_product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
              AND be.bom_level > 0
        ), 0) AS indirect_demand
    FROM northeast_orders no
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(direct_demand + indirect_demand) AS BIGINT) AS total_demand
FROM demand_calc

        go.order_date,

),

-- First, get all orders from Central territory in 2025
central_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id

      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
-- Find the product_id for FR-T98Y-54
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-T98Y-54'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion: for each product sold, find all components at all levels
-- We need to expand BOM valid on each specific order date
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: products directly ordered
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS assembly_id,
        co.product_id AS component_id,
        co.order_qty AS total_qty,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM central_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that have BOMs
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.component_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= be.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bom.end_date)
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
),
-- Get all instances where FR-T98Y-54 appears in the expansion
target_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.total_qty AS demand_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id
)
-- Sum all demand: direct sales (where root product is FR-T98Y-54) + contained in other products
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(demand_qty), 0) AS total_demand

    FROM product p

    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),

    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN australia_territory at ON so.territory_id = at.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),
bom_recursive AS (
    -- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all components at all levels
    -- Start with bike products as top-level assemblies
    SELECT 
        bp.product_id as top_level_product_id,
        bp.product_id as assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse: components that are manufactured in-house have their own BOMs
    SELECT 
        br.top_level_product_id,
        p.product_id as assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        br.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        bom.bom_level
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN product p ON br.component_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
bike_units_sold AS (
    -- Calculate total units sold for each bike (direct sales + component demand)
    SELECT 
        bp.product_number,
        -- Direct sales: the bike itself sold
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sol.product_id = bp.product_id THEN sol.order_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) +
        -- Component demand: all components at all BOM levels
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN br.component_id IS NOT NULL THEN sol.order_qty * br.total_qty
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ), 0) as total_units
    FROM bike_products bp
    LEFT JOIN orders_australia_2024 oa ON true
    LEFT JOIN sales_order_line sol ON oa.order_id = sol.order_id 
        AND (sol.product_id = bp.product_id OR sol.product_id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT br2.top_level_product_id 
            FROM bom_recursive br2 
            WHERE br2.top_level_product_id = bp.product_id
        ))
    LEFT JOIN bom_recursive br ON br.top_level_product_id = bp.product_id 
        AND sol.product_id = br.top_level_product_id
    WHERE oa.order_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bp.product_id, bp.product_number
)
SELECT product_number
FROM bike_units_sold
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all orders from Southwest territory in 2023
southwest_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Southwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Find the product_id for 'RW-M928'
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'RW-M928'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all paths from any product to RW-M928
-- We need to find: for each product sold, how many RW-M928 units are contained (including if sold directly)
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: start from products that have RW-M928 as a direct component
    -- Or RW-M928 itself (for direct sales)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as top_product_id,
        p.product_id as current_product_id,
        1.0 as qty_per_unit,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the current product as a component
    SELECT 
        a.product_id as top_product_id,
        bom.assembly_id as current_product_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * be.qty_per_unit as qty_per_unit,
        be.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON be.current_product_id = bom.component_id
    JOIN product a ON bom.assembly_id = a.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL  -- not a header row
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- We need to find demand for RW-M928: both direct and as component
-- For each order line, we need to check if the product is RW-M928 or contains it
-- First, get all valid BOM lines for each order date (for containment calculation)
valid_bom_on_date AS (
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Recursive CTE to find all components of a product on a specific date
product_components AS (
    -- Base: direct components
    SELECT 
        v.assembly_id as root_product_id,
        v.component_id,
        v.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        v.assembly_id as parent_id
    FROM valid_bom_on_date v
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of components
    SELECT 
        pc.root_product_id,
        v.component_id,
        pc.total_qty * v.per_assembly_qty as total_qty,
        v.assembly_id as parent_id
    FROM product_components pc
    JOIN valid_bom_on_date v ON pc.component_id = v.assembly_id
),
-- For each order, calculate demand for RW-M928
order_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        so.product_id,
        so.order_qty,
        -- Direct sales of RW-M928
        CASE WHEN so.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product) THEN so.order_qty ELSE 0 END as direct_demand,
        -- Component demand: sum of all paths from ordered product to RW-M928 valid on order date
        COALESCE((
            WITH RECURSIVE bom_path AS (
                -- Base: direct components on order date
                SELECT 
                    bom.component_id,
                    bom.per_assembly_qty as qty
                FROM bill_of_materials bom
                WHERE bom.assembly_id = so.product_id
                  AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND bom.start_date <= so.order_date
                  AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= so.order_date)
                
                UNION ALL
                
                -- Recursive: deeper components
                SELECT 
                    bom.component_id,
                    bp.qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as qty
                FROM bom_path bp
                JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bp.component_id = bom.assembly_id
                WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND bom.start_date <= so.order_date
                  AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= so.order_date)
            )
            SELECT SUM(bp.qty * so.order_qty)
            FROM bom_path bp
            WHERE bp.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
        ), 0) as component_demand
    FROM southwest_orders so
)
SELECT 
    SUM(direct_demand + component_demand) as total_demand
FROM order_demand

WITH RECURSIVE bom_hierarchy AS (
    -- Base case: all products that contain HB-T721 directly or indirectly
    -- First, find HB-T721's product_id
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as top_product_id,
        p.product_id as current_product_id,
        p.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as per_assembly_qty,
        0 as bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'HB-T721'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find assemblies that contain the current component
    SELECT 
        bh.top_product_id,
        bom.assembly_id as current_product_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty * bh.per_assembly_qty as per_assembly_qty,
        bh.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_hierarchy bh
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bh.current_product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
        AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
        AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get all paths from top-level products to HB-T721
bom_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        bh.top_product_id,
        bh.per_assembly_qty as total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_hierarchy bh
    WHERE bh.component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'HB-T721')
        AND bh.bom_level > 0
),
-- Direct sales of HB-T721
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty), 0) as direct_demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON c.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'HB-T721'
        AND st.name = 'United Kingdom'
        AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
        AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
-- Indirect demand: HB-T721 contained in other products sold
indirect_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty * bp.total_qty_per_unit), 0) as indirect_demand
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customer c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON c.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON sol.product_id = bp.top_product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'United Kingdom'
        AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
        AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT direct_demand FROM direct_sales) + 
    (SELECT indirect_demand FROM indirect_demand) as total_demand

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, identify the target product
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
),

-- Get all order lines from Canada in 2023 with their dates
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: for each product, find all components at all levels
-- We need to find paths from any product down to FR-R92R-62
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components from any assembly
    SELECT 
        b.assembly_id AS top_product_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        b.start_date,
        b.end_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        be.top_product_id,
        b.component_id,
        be.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        GREATEST(be.start_date, b.start_date) AS start_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.end_date IS NULL THEN b.end_date
            WHEN b.end_date IS NULL THEN be.end_date
            ELSE LEAST(be.end_date, b.end_date)
        END AS end_date,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON be.component_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      -- Date overlap check for validity
      AND (be.end_date IS NULL OR b.start_date <= be.end_date)
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR be.start_date <= b.end_date)
),

-- Find all paths from products to FR-R92R-62
paths_to_target AS (
    -- Direct: FR-R92R-62 is sold directly (no BOM path needed, will be handled separately)
    
    -- Through BOM: products that contain FR-R92R-62 as a component
    SELECT 
        be.top_product_id,
        be.total_qty,
        be.start_date,
        be.end_date
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN target_product tp ON be.component_id = tp.product_id
),

-- Calculate demand: direct sales + component usage
demand_calc AS (
    -- Direct sales of FR-R92R-62
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty), 0) AS direct_demand
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN target_product tp ON co.product_id = tp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Component demand: products sold that contain FR-R92R-62
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(co.order_qty * ptt.total_qty), 0) AS component_demand
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN paths_to_target ptt ON co.product_id = ptt.top_product_id
    WHERE co.order_date >= ptt.start_date
      AND (ptt.end_date IS NULL OR co.order_date <= ptt.end_date)
)

SELECT SUM(direct_demand) AS total_demand FROM demand_calc;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, identify the product_id for FK-9939
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'FK-9939'
),

-- Get all Northwest territory orders in 2024
northwest_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines for Northwest 2024 orders
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        no.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN northwest_orders no ON sol.order_id = no.order_id
),

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from products to their components
-- We need to find, for each product sold, how many FK-9939 are contained in it
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: start from all products that have BOM lines
    -- We need to trace backwards: FK-9939 can be a component of assemblies
    -- So we start with FK-9939 as a component and find what assemblies contain it
    SELECT 
        b.component_id AS start_component_id,
        b.assembly_id AS current_product_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN target_product tp ON b.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go up the BOM tree (find assemblies that contain the current assembly)
    SELECT 
        be.start_component_id,
        b.assembly_id AS current_product_id,
        be.qty_multiplier * b.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON be.current_product_id = b.component_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),

-- Also need direct sales of FK-9939 itself
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier  -- Direct sale, no BOM multiplication
    FROM order_lines sol
    JOIN target_product tp ON sol.product_id = tp.product_id
),

-- Indirect sales: products that contain FK-9939 in their BOM
indirect_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id AS sold_product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        be.qty_multiplier
    FROM order_lines sol
    JOIN bom_expansion be ON sol.product_id = be.current_product_id
),

-- Combine direct and indirect, but need to filter by BOM validity on order date
-- We need to re-check BOM validity on each specific order date
all_containing_paths AS (
    -- Direct: FK-9939 sold as itself
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        1.0 AS total_qty_per_unit,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN target_product tp ON ol.product_id = tp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Indirect: FK-9939 contained in other products
    -- Need to calculate the proper multiplier by walking the BOM on the order date
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS top_level_product_id,
        ol.order_qty,
        -- Calculate multiplier by recursive walk from top-level product down to FK-9939
        -- We need a separate recursive CTE for this
        NULL AS total_qty_per_unit,  -- Placeholder, will calculate properly
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bom_expansion be WHERE be.current_product_id = ol.product_id
    )
),

-- Proper recursive calculation: from each sold product, expand down to find FK-9939
bom_downward AS (
    -- Base: start from sold products, expand their BOM
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id AS root_product_id,
        ol.product_id AS current_id,
        ol.order_qty AS root_qty,
        1.0 AS multiplier,
        ol.order_date
    FROM order_lines ol
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand components
    SELECT 
        bd.order_id,
        bd.root_product_id,
        b.component_id AS current_id,
        bd.root_qty,
        bd.multiplier * b.per_assembly_qty AS multiplier,
        bd.order_date
    FROM bom_downward bd
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON bd.current_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND b.start_date <= bd.order_date
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR bd.order_date <= b.end_date)
      -- Prevent infinite loops (though BOM shouldn't have cycles)
      AND bd.multiplier * b.per_assembly_qty < 1000000
),

-- Filter to only paths ending at FK-9939
fk_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        bd.order_id,
        bd.root_product_id,
        bd.root_qty,
        bd.multiplier AS qty_per_unit,
        bd.order_date
    FROM bom_downward bd
    JOIN target_product tp ON bd.current_id = tp.product_id
)

-- Sum up all demand: direct sales + contained in other products
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(fp.root_qty * fp.qty_per_unit AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS total_demand
FROM fk_paths fp;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Parse the target product and part
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'BK-R89B-44'
),
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id 
    FROM product 
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-0253'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion for a given date
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the target product as assembly, quantity 1
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as assembly_id,
        p.product_id as component_id,
        1.0 as per_unit_qty,
        0 as level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        be.per_unit_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as per_unit_qty,
        be.level + 1 as level
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.component_id
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bom.component_id
    WHERE 
        -- Only expand if the parent component is manufactured (has its own BOM)
        -- Actually we need to check if the component in the previous level is an assembly
        -- The BOM line gives us the component, and we need that component's own BOM if it's make_flag=true
        -- But actually we just follow all BOM lines; the make_flag determines if a product has BOM entries
        -- We follow all valid BOM lines for the given date
        bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get all leaf parts (purchased components, make_flag = false) for a specific date
-- We need to filter by date in the recursive CTE, so we'll create a function-like CTE
bom_for_date AS (
    SELECT 
        bom.assembly_id,
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty,
        bom.start_date,
        bom.end_date
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Recursive expansion with date filter
bom_recursive(assembly_id, component_id, per_unit_qty, level, valid_date) AS (
    -- Anchor
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_id,
        1.0,
        0,
        DATE '2021-10-16' as valid_date
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step for 2021-10-16
    SELECT 
        br.assembly_id,
        bfd.component_id,
        br.per_unit_qty * bfd.per_assembly_qty,
        br.level + 1,
        br.valid_date
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN bom_for_date bfd ON bfd.assembly_id = br.component_id
    WHERE 
        br.valid_date = DATE '2021-10-16'
        AND bfd.start_date <= br.valid_date 
        AND (bfd.end_date IS NULL OR bfd.end_date >= br.valid_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Anchor for current date
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_id,
        1.0,
        0,
        DATE '2025-06-30' as valid_date
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_product)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step for current date
    SELECT 
        br.assembly_id,
        bfd.component_id,
        br.per_unit_qty * bfd.per_assembly_qty,
        br.level + 1,
        br.valid_date
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN bom_for_date bfd ON bfd.assembly_id = br.component_id
    WHERE 
        br.valid_date = DATE '2025-06-30'
        AND bfd.start_date <= br.valid_date 
        AND (bfd.end_date IS NULL OR bfd.end_date >= br.valid_date)
),
-- Get leaf nodes (parts) for each date
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        br.valid_date,
        br.component_id,
        br.per_unit_qty
    FROM bom_recursive br
    WHERE 
        -- A leaf is a component that has no valid BOM lines as assembly on that date,
        -- OR we can check if make_flag = false
        br.component_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE make_flag = false)
),
-- Sum quantities for the target part on each date
part_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        valid_date,
        SUM(per_unit_qty) as total_qty
    FROM leaf_parts
    WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM target_part)
    GROUP BY valid_date
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT total_qty FROM part_quantities WHERE valid_date = DATE '2025-06-30'), 
        0
    ) - 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT total_qty FROM part_quantities WHERE valid_date = DATE '2021-10-16'), 
        0
    ) as qty_change;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get all products in 'Cranksets' subcategory
crankset_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    WHERE ps.name = 'Cranksets'
),
-- Get Southwest territory
southwest_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id
    FROM sales_territory
    WHERE name = 'Southwest'
),
-- Non-online orders in 2025 for Southwest
reseller_orders_2025 AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN southwest_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE so.online_order = false
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get order lines for products that are cranksets or contain cranksets in their BOM
-- First, find all crankset products that appear as sold items or components
-- We need to explode BOMs to find when cranksets are components

-- Recursive BOM traversal: find all paths from parent products to crankset components
-- Starting from all products, traverse down to find cranksets as children
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base: direct parent-child where child is a crankset
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as top_product_id,
        p.product_number as top_product_number,
        c.product_id as component_id,
        c.product_number as component_number,
        uc.qty as path_qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN product p ON uc.parent_code = p.product_number
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    JOIN crankset_products cp ON c.product_id = cp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go deeper - parent of current top_product
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as top_product_id,
        p.product_number as top_product_number,
        bp.component_id,
        bp.component_number,
        uc.qty * bp.path_qty as path_qty,
        GREATEST(uc.valid_from, bp.valid_from) as valid_from,
        LEAST(COALESCE(uc.valid_to, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(bp.valid_to, '9999-12-31')) as valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN product p ON uc.parent_code = p.product_number
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON uc.child_code = bp.top_product_number
    WHERE GREATEST(uc.valid_from, bp.valid_from) <= LEAST(COALESCE(uc.valid_to, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(bp.valid_to, '9999-12-31'))
),
-- For each order line, determine crankset demand
-- This includes: direct sales of cranksets + cranksets as components
order_line_crankset_demand AS (
    -- Direct sales of crankset products
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty as crankset_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN crankset_products cp ON sol.product_id = cp.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Cranksets as components in BOMs valid on order date
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        bp.component_id as product_id,
        (sol.order_qty * bp.path_qty)::INT as crankset_qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON sol.product_id = bp.top_product_id
    JOIN reseller_orders_2025 ro ON sol.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.order_date >= bp.valid_from 
      AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR ro.order_date <= bp.valid_to)
),
-- Filter to only our target orders and sum
final_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        ocd.crankset_qty
    FROM order_line_crankset_demand ocd
    JOIN reseller_orders_2025 ro ON ocd.order_id = ro.order_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crankset_qty), 0) as total_crankset_units_sold
FROM final_demand

    FROM product

    WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'

-- Recursive BOM expansion: find all paths from sold products to TT-M928
-- We need to go from parent to child, tracking cumulative quantity
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct sales of TT-M928 (0 levels of BOM)
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        co.product_id as parent_product_id,
        co.order_qty as cumulative_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 as level,
        co.product_id as root_product_id
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN part_info pi ON co.product_id = pi.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also base case: products that have TT-M928 as direct child in BOM
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.line_id,
        p.product_id as parent_product_id,
        co.order_qty * uc.qty as cumulative_qty,
        co.order_date,
        1 as level,
        co.product_id as root_product_id
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN part_info pi ON uc.child_code = pi.product_number
    WHERE co.order_date >= uc.valid_from 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR co.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper into BOM
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.line_id,
        p.product_id as parent_product_id,
        bp.cumulative_qty * uc.qty as cumulative_qty,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.level + 1,
        bp.root_product_id

    JOIN product p ON bp.parent_product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p.product_number = uc.parent_code

      AND child_p.make_flag = true  -- Continue only if child is manufactured

      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

              SELECT uc2.child_code, uc2.qty

              FROM check_path cp
              JOIN u_composition uc3 ON cp.child_code = uc3.parent_code
              WHERE bp.order_date >= uc3.valid_from 
                AND (uc3.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc3.valid_to)

        co.line_id,

        p.product_number as current_code,
        co.order_qty as total_qty,
        co.order_date,
        0 as level

    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    
    UNION ALL

        fb.line_id,

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get the territory_id for Canada
canada_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id 
    FROM sales_territory 
    WHERE name = 'Canada'
),

-- Get all orders from Canada in 2023
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN canada_territory ct ON so.territory_id = ct.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines from Canada in 2023 with product info
canada_order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        col.order_id,
        col.line_id,
        col.product_id,
        col.order_qty,
        p.product_number,
        co.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line col
    JOIN canada_orders co ON col.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN product p ON col.product_id = p.product_id
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode BOM: find all paths from products to their components
-- We need to find all products that contain FR-R92R-62 at any level, and how many
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children in BOM
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: go deeper
    SELECT 
        be.parent_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(be.valid_from, uc.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE be.child_code != 'FR-R92R-62' -- Stop if we found our target
),

-- Find all products that directly contain FR-R92R-62
direct_containment AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code,
        'FR-R92R-62' AS child_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE child_code = 'FR-R92R-62'
),

-- Find all products that indirectly contain FR-R92R-62 through bom_explosion
indirect_containment AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code,
        child_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE child_code = 'FR-R92R-62'
),

-- Combine all containment relationships
all_containment AS (
    SELECT * FROM direct_containment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM indirect_containment
),

-- Calculate demand from products that contain FR-R92R-62 in their BOM
contained_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(col.order_qty * ac.qty) AS demand
    FROM canada_order_lines col
    JOIN all_containment ac ON col.product_number = ac.parent_code
    WHERE col.order_date >= ac.valid_from 
      AND (ac.valid_to IS NULL OR col.order_date <= ac.valid_to)
),

-- Calculate direct demand for FR-R92R-62 itself
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(col.order_qty) AS demand
    FROM canada_order_lines col
    WHERE col.product_number = 'FR-R92R-62'
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT demand FROM direct_demand), 0) + 
    COALESCE((SELECT demand FROM contained_demand), 0) AS total_demand
```

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the specified bikes
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code AS root_child
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code IN ('BK-T44U-46', 'BK-M18B-52')
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of manufactured components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty * bt.qty,
        c.parent_code,
        bt.root_child
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON c.parent_code = bt.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
parts_in_bikes AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.child_code AS part_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.root_child IN (
            SELECT child_code FROM u_composition 
            WHERE parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46'
              AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
              AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
        ) OR bt.parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_t44,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bt.root_child IN (
            SELECT child_code FROM u_composition 
            WHERE parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52'
              AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
              AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
        ) OR bt.parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_m18
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bt.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE  -- only purchased parts
    GROUP BY bt.child_code
)
SELECT part_number
FROM parts_in_bikes
WHERE in_t44 = 1 AND in_m18 = 0
ORDER BY part_number;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_edges AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code,
        child_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
),
bom_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_code,
        child_code,
        qty AS path_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_edges
    WHERE child_code = 'TT-M928'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.parent_code,
        p.child_code,
        e.qty * p.path_qty AS path_qty,
        e.valid_from,
        e.valid_to
    FROM bom_edges e
    JOIN bom_paths p ON e.child_code = p.parent_code
    WHERE e.valid_from <= p.valid_from
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= p.valid_from)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(demand.qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM (
    -- Direct demand: order lines for TT-M928 itself
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'TT-M928'
      AND st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Indirect demand: components contained in sold products
    SELECT 
        sol.order_qty * bp.path_qty AS qty
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON bp.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND bp.valid_from <= so.order_date
      AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.valid_to >= so.order_date)
) demand;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_edges AS (

    FROM u_composition
),
bom_paths AS (
    SELECT

        qty AS path_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_edges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        bp.parent_code,
        be.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * be.qty AS path_qty,
        be.valid_from,
        be.valid_to
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.child_code = be.parent_code
    WHERE be.valid_from <= bp.valid_to
      AND (be.valid_to IS NULL OR be.valid_to >= bp.valid_from)
),
demand_components AS (
    SELECT
        sol.order_id,
        sol.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date,
        so.territory_id
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT
        dc.order_id,
        dc.order_qty AS units
    FROM demand_components dc
    WHERE dc.product_number = 'MS-2348'
),
indirect_demand AS (
    SELECT
        dc.order_id,
        dc.order_qty * bp.path_qty AS units
    FROM demand_components dc
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON dc.product_number = bp.parent_code
    WHERE bp.child_code = 'MS-2348'
      AND bp.valid_from <= dc.order_date
      AND (bp.valid_to IS NULL OR dc.order_date <= bp.valid_to)
),
all_demand AS (
    SELECT order_id, units FROM direct_demand
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, units FROM indirect_demand
)
SELECT SUM(ad.units) AS total_demand
FROM all_demand ad
JOIN sales_order so ON ad.order_id = so.order_id

      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2021-08-05'
